title: OVERPOP
notes: Single source of truth for build progress. Every step is independently verifiable from disk. A cold session resumes with: node tools/state.mjs brief

phases.title: Scaffold, contract & resumability
phases.goal: Repo skeleton, static-site furniture, and the frozen engine contract every later phase codes against.

steps.title: ARCHITECTURE.md — frozen engine contract
verify: node tools/state.mjs grep ARCHITECTURE.md 'Tower module contract'
steps.note: Must define: track model, balloon layer model, damage/immunity matrix, tower module shape, projectile contract, fixed-step order. Frozen before any fan-out.

steps.title: Static site furniture (index.html, style.css, CNAME, SEO, PWA)
steps.note: Classic <script src> only — no ES modules in the browser bundle, so the game runs from file://. Visually-hidden <h1>+prose behind the canvas (canvas-game SEO fix).

steps.title: README.md with explicit scope + non-affiliation disclaimer
steps.note: State what is in scope and what is honestly cut. Mirror the EA/PopCap disclaimer style from the pvz repo.

phases.title: Spine — deterministic simulation core
phases.goal: One-voice engine core. Written inline, not fanned out. Everything later depends on these signatures.

steps.title: Seeded RNG + math/geometry helpers
steps.note: sfc32 or mulberry32. Determinism is the foundation of the whole verification story.

steps.title: Track model — polyline with scalar distance t
steps.note: t = distance travelled along path. First/Last targeting = max/min t. Leak = t >= length. Children spawn at parent t. Supports multiple concurrent paths + entry/exit pairs.

steps.title: Balloon layer model + child cascade
steps.note: A balloon is a layer index, not an entity. Blimp class carries HP. Properties: veiled (camo), regen, plated (fortified). Ladder: red..ceramic, then GOLIATH/LEVIATHAN/COLOSSUS/WRAITH/OMEN.

steps.title: Damage-type x immunity matrix (data-driven)
steps.note: lead/sharp, black/explosion, white/cold, zebra(both), purple(magic-fire-plasma-energy). No if-chains — a table.

steps.title: Projectiles — per-projectile hit sets, pierce, pooling
steps.note: A projectile must never hit the same balloon twice; pierce counts DISTINCT balloons. Swept collision, not per-frame AABB.

steps.title: Spatial grid + targeting priorities
steps.note: First/Last/Close/Strong + tower-specific extras. Camo detection gating. Line-of-sight for blocked maps.

steps.title: Fixed-timestep sim loop + entity orchestration
steps.note: Accumulator, fixed dt. Documented update order. Determinism checksum must match across two runs of the same seed.

steps.title: Economy, lives, round runner, status effects
steps.note: Cash per pop scaled by difficulty, leak damage by RBE, freeze/glue/stun stacking rules.

steps.title: Tower module contract + _TEMPLATE.js + upgrade-tree engine
steps.note: 3 paths x 5 tiers, crosspath rules (one path to 3+ locks others at 2; only one path past 2). Abilities with cooldowns. THIS IS THE FROZEN CONTRACT for the P3 fan-out.

steps.title: Headless verification harness
steps.note: Loads the classic-script browser bundle into a Node sandbox so the same code is tested. Suites + seeded round playthroughs + determinism checksums.

phases.title: Waves, difficulties & game modes
phases.goal: The 100-round set, freeplay scaling, difficulty and mode matrix.

steps.title: Standard round set 1-100 + RBE table
steps.note: Monotonic RBE growth, correct first-appearance rounds per balloon type, blimp introductions.

steps.title: Alternate wave set + freeplay generator (rounds 101+)
steps.note: Freeplay must scale HP/speed without ever generating an unwinnable-by-construction wave.

steps.title: Difficulties + game modes matrix
steps.note: Easy/Medium/Hard/Relentless. Modes: Standard, Primary Only, Military Only, Magic Only, Deflation, Onslaught, Half Cash, Double HP Blimps, Alternate Waves, Reverse, PURIST.

phases.title: Tower roster — 25 towers, 3x5 upgrade trees
phases.goal: Fan-out phase. One agent per family, disjoint files, all coding against the P1.9 contract.

steps.title: Primary family (7 towers)
steps.note: Acorn Fox, Boomer Badger, Cannon Boar, Thistle Hedgehog, Frost Hare, Sap Snail, Sixgun Stoat.

steps.title: Military family (7 towers)
steps.note: Longshot Lynx, Diver Otter, Corsair Beaver, Biplane Magpie, Rotor Kestrel, Howitzer Mole, Gatling Raccoon.

steps.title: Magic family (6 towers)
steps.note: Rune Weasel, Elder Owl, Shadow Marten, Brewer Toad, Thornroot Stag, Tidecaller Newt.

steps.title: Support family (5 towers)
steps.note: Berry Warren, Caltrop Beetle, Warren Hall, Tinker Shrew, Falconer Ferret. Buff aggregation must be idempotent and order-independent.

steps.title: Paragon system + paragon tier for a subset
steps.note: Degree 1-100 from sacrificed-tower value. Not every tower gets one — say which in the README.

phases.title: Heroes
phases.goal: XP-levelling heroes with per-level unlocks and ultimates.

steps.title: Hero framework (XP curve, 20 levels, one-per-game rule)
steps.note: XP from pops + round-passive. Level thresholds scale with difficulty.

steps.title: Hero roster (8 heroes)
steps.note: Each with a distinct mechanical identity, not just stat curves.

phases.title: Maps
phases.goal: Original maps across difficulty tiers with varied path topology.

steps.title: Map format + loader + placement masks
steps.note: Land/water/blocked masks, line-of-sight obstacles, multi-path, removable obstacles.

steps.title: 16 maps (beginner -> expert)
steps.note: Every map must be provably completable: harness plays a reference build on it.

phases.title: Presentation — sprites & rendering
phases.goal: All art drawn procedurally in code. Woodland-critter theme. No asset packs.

steps.title: Render core (camera, layers, culling, canvas pooling)
steps.note: Render must never mutate sim state. Offscreen-canvas caching for static map layers.

steps.title: Balloon + blimp sprites, pop FX, damage FX
steps.note: Must read at 20px. Veiled/regen/plated need distinct silhouettes, not just tints.

steps.title: Critter tower sprites (25 towers x visible tier states)
steps.note: Silhouette must change as upgrades land, so the board is readable at a glance.

phases.title: Audio
phases.goal: WebAudio synthesis only, no sample files.

steps.title: Synth engine + SFX bank + music beds
steps.note: Voice limiting is mandatory — round 90 fires hundreds of pops per second.

steps.title: Save system + settings + profile progression
steps.note: Versioned schema with migrations. Mid-round save/resume must round-trip a live sim exactly.

steps.title: In-game HUD, shop, upgrade panel, targeting controls
steps.note: Touch and mouse. Upgrade panel must show crosspath locks honestly.

steps.title: Boot wiring — main.js + ordered script list
steps.note: Script order in index.html must match dependency order — classic scripts, no module resolution to save us.

phases.title: Verification & balance
phases.goal: Prove it plays, deterministically, without hand-playing 100 rounds.

steps.title: Full-suite green + determinism checksums
steps.note: Same seed twice -> identical checksum.

steps.title: Scripted playthroughs: rounds 1-100 x difficulties x key modes
steps.note: Reference builds must survive; a deliberately bad build must leak. Both directions matter.

steps.title: Browser smoke test (headless chromium, console-error free)
steps.note: Boots index.html from file://, plays rounds via injected input, asserts zero console errors + frame budget.

steps.title: Adversarial review pass on spine + content

phases.title: Assets
phases.goal: Icons, share image, hub screenshot — all generated, all committed.

steps.title: og-image.png (1200x630) + hub screenshot (1000x525)
steps.note: Hub shot must be exactly 1000x525 to match topout.png/defenders.png aspect-ratio.

phases.title: Ship
phases.goal: Live at overpop.andrenijman.com and linked from the hub.

steps.title: Create private repo + push build branch + merge to main
steps.note: Private, matching pvz/topout/games-site.

steps.title: Enable Pages (main root) + custom domain
steps.note: Publish from main root, legacy build — CNAME file committed. Do NOT copy the pvz pages.yml (pinned to a dead branch).

steps.title: Cloudflare DNS record (grey cloud)
steps.note: CNAME overpop -> andrenijman.github.io, proxy OFF (required for GitHub to issue the Let's Encrypt cert). Token at ~/special.txt. If GitHub's domain check fails mid-edit, remove and re-add the custom domain to force a recheck.

steps.title: games-site hub: card + meta + JSON-LD + sitemap
steps.note: Not just a card: meta description, og:description, twitter:description all currently name only TOPOUT and Garden Defenders 2. JSON-LD needs itemListElement position 3. sitemap lastmod bump. overpop.png at 1000x525.

steps.note: projects/overpop.md, decisions/2026-08-05-overpop-name-and-theme.md, journal append. Written as we go, not batched.
